issues.description: _copy_file() used os.link() (hardlink) with copy fallback only on OSError. On this NTFS volume hardlinking always succeeded, so staged artifacts were the same inode as their source with zero hash verification -- a source mutation after staging silently propagated to the staged copy.
issues.proof: Failing test: mutate source after staging, staged copy changed too (pre-fix).
issues.scientific_runtime_consequence: Staged/packaged artifacts could not be trusted as independent, content-addressed copies -- undermines every downstream SHA-256 authority claim for staged large-map packages.

issues.description: generate_tile_fbx()'s result.status was hardcoded to "ok" unconditionally regardless of the tri-state roundtrip_ok (True/False/None) result -- a real geometry-roundtrip mismatch would never fail scripts/cook_full_grid_tiles.py's exit code.
issues.proof: Original audit framing (single hardcoded assignment at point of origin, not a later write clobbering an earlier FAIL -- corrected by the fixing subagent).
issues.scientific_runtime_consequence: A silently corrupted FBX roundtrip could pass the whole tile-cook pipeline undetected.

issues.description: MainPipeline.run() produces map_acceptance.json, map_content_fingerprint.json, preflight validation, and a determinism fingerprint BEFORE junction_link_integrity and map_hygiene run -- both of which can mutate structure (patch links; quarantine/delete roads; modify lanes; repair z-seams/lane-width discontinuities; add G6 lane links). Pipeline-level acceptance/fingerprints may therefore certify a pre-final XODR.

issues.scientific_runtime_consequence: Every downstream consumer of map_acceptance.json/map_content_fingerprint.json (including research campaigns) may be trusting evidence about a map state that doesn't match what's actually on disk as "final".

issues.description: 3007/45178 lane-count transitions are classified 'unexplained' because the 'explained' bucket requires OSM lane_count_source provenance that only 0.4% of driving lanes carry at all -- a measurement-design problem, not necessarily 3007 real defects. No classification currently distinguishes ordinary merge/split/junction transitions from genuinely suspicious ones.
issues.proof: 2026-09-17 investigation (see memory project_step7_empty_planview_connector_bug_20260916): gate postdates the previous pin, first-ever measurement, 0.4% provenance coverage confirmed.
issues.scientific_runtime_consequence: Cannot currently distinguish a real generator defect from expected, benign lane-count transitions at this scale -- blocks confident production certification of the lane-topology gate.
